items.text: When I stopped the machine at last. <break time="0.8s" /> I found myself sitting. <break time="0.8s" /> On soft grass in a little garden. <break time="0.8s" /> In the middle of a heavy hailstorm. <break time="0.8s" /> The dials on the machine. <break time="0.8s" /> Told me an astonishing fact. <break time="0.8s" /> That I had arrived. <break time="0.8s" /> In the year 802, 701. <break time="0.8s" /> Through the gray curtain of hail. <break time="0.8s" /> I saw a huge white figure. <break time="0.8s" /> Which looked like a sphinx. <break time="0.8s" /> With its wings spread wide. <break time="0.8s" /> It stood on a bronze pedestal. <break time="0.8s" /> And its face. <break time="0.8s" /> Which was turned toward me. <break time="0.8s" /> Seemed to wear. <break time="0.8s" /> A faint and unpleasant smile. <break time="0.8s" /> As the hail grew thinner. <break time="0.8s" /> I saw great buildings. <break time="0.8s" /> Rising among the trees. <break time="0.8s" /> And a sudden fear. <break time="0.8s" /> Took hold of me. <break time="0.8s" /> What if the people of this age. <break time="0.8s" /> Had become cruel and powerful. <break time="0.8s" /> And treated me. <break time="0.8s" /> Like a wild animal from the past. <break time="0.8s" /> In a panic. <break time="0.8s" /> I tried to set the machine upright again. <break time="0.8s" /> Ready to escape. <break time="0.8s" /> When I saw figures. <break time="0.8s" /> Coming out of a nearby building. <break time="0.8s" /> Never had I felt. <break time="0.8s" /> So helpless and alone. <break time="0.8s" /> As I did at that moment. <break time="0.8s" /> In that strange new world.

When I stopped the machine at last, I found myself sitting on soft grass in a little garden, in the middle of a heavy hailstorm. <break time="0.8s" /> The dials on the machine told me an astonishing fact, that I had arrived in the year 802, 701. <break time="0.8s" /> Through the gray curtain of hail, I saw a huge white figure, which looked like a sphinx with its wings spread wide. <break time="0.8s" /> It stood on a bronze pedestal, and its face, which was turned toward me, seemed to wear a faint and unpleasant smile. <break time="0.8s" /> As the hail grew thinner, I saw great buildings rising among the trees, and a sudden fear took hold of me. <break time="0.8s" /> What if the people of this age had become cruel and powerful, and treated me like a wild animal from the past. <break time="0.8s" /> In a panic I tried to set the machine upright again, ready to escape, when I saw figures coming out of a nearby building. <break time="0.8s" /> Never had I felt so helpless and alone as I did at that moment in that strange new world.

마침내 내가 기계를 멈췄을 때. <break time="0.8s" /> 나는 내가 앉아 있다는 것을 알았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 작은 정원의 부드러운 풀밭 위에. <break time="0.8s" /> 거센 우박이 쏟아지는 한가운데에. <break time="0.8s" /> 기계의 눈금판이. <break time="0.8s" /> 내게 놀라운 사실을 알려 주었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 내가 도착했다는 것이었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 80만 2701년에. <break time="0.8s" /> 잿빛 장막 같은 우박 사이로. <break time="0.8s" /> 나는 거대한 하얀 형상을 보았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그것은 스핑크스처럼 보였다. <break time="0.8s" /> 날개를 활짝 편 채. <break time="0.8s" /> 그것은 청동 받침대 위에 서 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 그 얼굴은. <break time="0.8s" /> 내 쪽을 향하고 있었는데. <break time="0.8s" /> 띠고 있는 듯했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 희미하고 불쾌한 미소를. <break time="0.8s" /> 우박이 잦아들자. <break time="0.8s" /> 나는 거대한 건물들을 보았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 나무들 사이로 솟아 있는. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 갑작스러운 두려움이. <break time="0.8s" /> 나를 사로잡았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 만약 이 시대의 사람들이. <break time="0.8s" /> 잔인하고 강해졌다면 어떻게 할 것인가. <break time="0.8s" /> 그래서 나를 다룬다면. <break time="0.8s" /> 과거에서 온 야생 동물처럼. <break time="0.8s" /> 겁에 질려. <break time="0.8s" /> 나는 기계를 다시 똑바로 세우려 했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 도망칠 준비를 한 채. <break time="0.8s" /> 그때 사람들이 보였다. <break time="0.8s" /> 근처 건물에서 나오는. <break time="0.8s" /> 나는 결코 느낀 적이 없었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그토록 무력하고 외롭다고. <break time="0.8s" /> 그 순간만큼. <break time="0.8s" /> 그 낯선 새 세상에서.

One of them came straight toward me. <break time="0.8s" /> A slight creature. <break time="0.8s" /> About four feet tall. <break time="0.8s" /> Dressed in a purple tunic. <break time="0.8s" /> With a leather belt. <break time="0.8s" /> He was beautiful and graceful. <break time="0.8s" /> But he was so frail. <break time="0.8s" /> That he looked like a little figure. <break time="0.8s" /> Made of fine china. <break time="0.8s" /> Showing no sign of fear. <break time="0.8s" /> He came up and laughed into my eyes. <break time="0.8s" /> And then several others began. <break time="0.8s" /> To touch me with soft little hands. <break time="0.8s" /> Their voices were soft and sweet. <break time="0.8s" /> And there was something so childlike. <break time="0.8s" /> About them. <break time="0.8s" /> That my fear soon melted away. <break time="0.8s" /> Then, remembering the danger. <break time="0.8s" /> I quickly unscrewed the small levers. <break time="0.8s" /> That started the machine. <break time="0.8s" /> And put them safely in my pocket. <break time="0.8s" /> One of them pointed to the sun. <break time="0.8s" /> And asked me by signs. <break time="0.8s" /> Whether I had come from it. <break time="0.8s" /> In the thunderstorm. <break time="0.8s" /> The question surprised me. <break time="0.8s" /> For it was the kind of question. <break time="0.8s" /> That a five year old child of our time might ask. <break time="0.8s" /> Then they brought chains of beautiful flowers. <break time="0.8s" /> Which they hung around my neck. <break time="0.8s" /> Laughing until I was almost covered with them.

One of them came straight toward me, a slight creature about four feet tall, dressed in a purple tunic with a leather belt. <break time="0.8s" /> He was beautiful and graceful, but he was so frail that he looked like a little figure made of fine china. <break time="0.8s" /> Showing no sign of fear, he came up and laughed into my eyes, and then several others began to touch me with soft little hands. <break time="0.8s" /> Their voices were soft and sweet, and there was something so childlike about them that my fear soon melted away. <break time="0.8s" /> Then, remembering the danger, I quickly unscrewed the small levers that started the machine and put them safely in my pocket. <break time="0.8s" /> One of them pointed to the sun and asked me by signs whether I had come from it in the thunderstorm. <break time="0.8s" /> The question surprised me, for it was the kind of question that a five year old child of our time might ask. <break time="0.8s" /> Then they brought chains of beautiful flowers, which they hung around my neck, laughing, until I was almost covered with them.

그들 중 하나가 내게 곧장 다가왔다. <break time="0.8s" /> 가냘픈 존재였다. <break time="0.8s" /> 키가 4피트쯤 되는. <break time="0.8s" /> 자주색 튜닉을 입은. <break time="0.8s" /> 가죽 띠를 두른. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 아름답고 우아했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 그는 너무 연약해서. <break time="0.8s" /> 작은 인형처럼 보였다. <break time="0.8s" /> 고운 도자기로 만든. <break time="0.8s" /> 두려움의 기색을 전혀 보이지 않고. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 다가와 내 눈을 보며 웃었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그러자 다른 몇 명이 시작했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 부드럽고 작은 손으로 나를 만지기. <break time="0.8s" /> 그들의 목소리는 부드럽고 달콤했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 무언가 너무나 어린아이 같은 데가 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그들에게는. <break time="0.8s" /> 그래서 나의 두려움은 곧 녹아 없어졌다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그러다 위험이 떠올라. <break time="0.8s" /> 나는 작은 레버들을 재빨리 돌려 뺐다. <break time="0.8s" /> 기계를 움직이게 하는. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 그것들을 주머니에 안전하게 넣었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그들 중 하나가 태양을 가리켰다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 몸짓으로 내게 물었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 내가 태양에서 왔느냐고. <break time="0.8s" /> 그 뇌우 속에. <break time="0.8s" /> 그 질문은 나를 놀라게 했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그것은 그런 종류의 질문이었기 때문이다. <break time="0.8s" /> 우리 시대의 다섯 살짜리 아이나 할 법한. <break time="0.8s" /> 그러고 나서 그들은 아름다운 꽃 사슬을 가져왔다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그들은 그것을 내 목에 걸었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 웃으면서 내가 거의 꽃에 파묻힐 때까지.

They led me. <break time="0.8s" /> Into a vast building of gray stone. <break time="0.8s" /> Whose doorway was richly carved. <break time="0.8s" /> But badly broken and worn by time. <break time="0.8s" /> Inside was a great hall. <break time="0.8s" /> Full of tables made of polished stone. <break time="0.8s" /> On which lay heaps of fruit. <break time="0.8s" /> That I had never seen before. <break time="0.8s" /> The little people sat down on cushions. <break time="0.8s" /> And ate with their hands. <break time="0.8s" /> Throwing the peel and stalks. <break time="0.8s" /> Into round openings in the tables. <break time="0.8s" /> Following their example. <break time="0.8s" /> I ate too. <break time="0.8s" /> For I was very hungry and thirsty. <break time="0.8s" /> After my long journey through time. <break time="0.8s" /> Later I learned. <break time="0.8s" /> That these people ate nothing but fruit. <break time="0.8s" /> As the horses, cattle, and dogs of our age. <break time="0.8s" /> Had all disappeared. <break time="0.8s" /> I tried to learn their language. <break time="0.8s" /> By holding up a piece of fruit. <break time="0.8s" /> And asking its name. <break time="0.8s" /> Which made them laugh with delight. <break time="0.8s" /> But they were like small children. <break time="0.8s" /> Who soon grow tired of a game. <break time="0.8s" /> And after a few minutes. <break time="0.8s" /> They would wander away from me. <break time="0.8s" /> Seldom had I seen. <break time="0.8s" /> Such gentle people. <break time="0.8s" /> But I soon noticed. <break time="0.8s" /> Something strange about them. <break time="0.8s" /> A complete lack of interest. <break time="0.8s" /> In anything new.

They led me into a vast building of gray stone, whose doorway was richly carved but badly broken and worn by time. <break time="0.8s" /> Inside was a great hall full of tables made of polished stone, on which lay heaps of fruit that I had never seen before. <break time="0.8s" /> The little people sat down on cushions and ate with their hands, throwing the peel and stalks into round openings in the tables. <break time="0.8s" /> Following their example, I ate too, for I was very hungry and thirsty after my long journey through time. <break time="0.8s" /> Later I learned that these people ate nothing but fruit, as the horses, cattle, and dogs of our age had all disappeared. <break time="0.8s" /> I tried to learn their language by holding up a piece of fruit and asking its name, which made them laugh with delight. <break time="0.8s" /> But they were like small children who soon grow tired of a game, and after a few minutes they would wander away from me. <break time="0.8s" /> Seldom had I seen such gentle people, but I soon noticed something strange about them, a complete lack of interest in anything new.

그들은 나를 데려갔다. <break time="0.8s" /> 회색 돌로 지은 거대한 건물로. <break time="0.8s" /> 그 건물의 출입구는 화려하게 조각되어 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 세월에 몹시 부서지고 닳아 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 안에는 커다란 홀이 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 윤이 나는 돌로 만든 탁자들로 가득한. <break time="0.8s" /> 그 탁자 위에는 과일 더미가 놓여 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 내가 전에 한 번도 본 적 없는. <break time="0.8s" /> 작은 사람들은 방석에 앉았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 손으로 먹었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 껍질과 꼭지를 던져 넣으면서. <break time="0.8s" /> 탁자에 난 둥근 구멍 속으로. <break time="0.8s" /> 그들을 본받아. <break time="0.8s" /> 나도 먹었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 몹시 배고프고 목이 말랐기 때문이다. <break time="0.8s" /> 시간을 건너온 긴 여행 끝이라. <break time="0.8s" /> 나중에 나는 알게 되었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 이 사람들이 과일만 먹는다는 것을. <break time="0.8s" /> 우리 시대의 말과 소와 개가. <break time="0.8s" /> 모두 사라져 버렸기 때문이다. <break time="0.8s" /> 나는 그들의 말을 배우려 했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 과일 한 조각을 들어 올리고. <break time="0.8s" /> 그 이름을 물어보는 방법으로. <break time="0.8s" /> 그러자 그들은 기뻐하며 웃었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 그들은 어린아이들 같았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 놀이에 금방 싫증을 내는. <break time="0.8s" /> 그래서 몇 분이 지나면. <break time="0.8s" /> 그들은 내게서 슬슬 떠나가곤 했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 나는 좀처럼 본 적이 없었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그렇게 온화한 사람들을. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 나는 곧 알아차렸다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그들에게서 이상한 점을. <break time="0.8s" /> 관심이 완전히 없다는 것이었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 새로운 것에 대한.

Leaving the hall. <break time="0.8s" /> I climbed a hill. <break time="0.8s" /> And looked out over a world. <break time="0.8s" /> That had become one great garden. <break time="0.8s" /> Without fences or signs of work. <break time="0.8s" /> There were no small houses anywhere. <break time="0.8s" /> And the men and women. <break time="0.8s" /> Looked and dressed so much alike. <break time="0.8s" /> That I could hardly tell them apart. <break time="0.8s" /> Sitting on a seat of yellow metal. <break time="0.8s" /> As the sun went down. <break time="0.8s" /> I thought about why mankind had become so weak and gentle. <break time="0.8s" /> Long ago, I guessed. <break time="0.8s" /> People had conquered nature. <break time="0.8s" /> And made life perfectly safe. <break time="0.8s" /> So there was no more need. <break time="0.8s" /> For strength or courage. <break time="0.8s" /> The struggle having ended. <break time="0.8s" /> Their bodies and minds. <break time="0.8s" /> Had slowly grown soft. <break time="0.8s" /> And this, I thought. <break time="0.8s" /> Was the sunset of mankind. <break time="0.8s" /> The moon was rising. <break time="0.8s" /> When I came down the hill. <break time="0.8s" /> And I looked toward the little lawn. <break time="0.8s" /> Where I had left my machine. <break time="0.8s" /> The lawn was there. <break time="0.8s" /> And the white sphinx. <break time="0.8s" /> Gleamed in the moonlight. <break time="0.8s" /> But the Time Machine was gone. <break time="0.8s" /> I ran wildly. <break time="0.8s" /> Around the sphinx and through the bushes. <break time="0.8s" /> But there was no sign of the machine anywhere. <break time="0.8s" /> And a terrible fear seized me.

Leaving the hall, I climbed a hill and looked out over a world that had become one great garden, without fences or signs of work. <break time="0.8s" /> There were no small houses anywhere, and the men and women looked and dressed so much alike that I could hardly tell them apart. <break time="0.8s" /> Sitting on a seat of yellow metal as the sun went down, I thought about why mankind had become so weak and gentle. <break time="0.8s" /> Long ago, I guessed, people had conquered nature and made life perfectly safe, so there was no more need for strength or courage. <break time="0.8s" /> The struggle having ended, their bodies and minds had slowly grown soft, and this, I thought, was the sunset of mankind. <break time="0.8s" /> The moon was rising when I came down the hill, and I looked toward the little lawn where I had left my machine. <break time="0.8s" /> The lawn was there, and the white sphinx gleamed in the moonlight, but the Time Machine was gone. <break time="0.8s" /> I ran wildly around the sphinx and through the bushes, but there was no sign of the machine anywhere, and a terrible fear seized me.

홀을 나와. <break time="0.8s" /> 나는 언덕에 올랐다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 세상을 내려다보았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그 세상은 하나의 거대한 정원이 되어 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 울타리도 일한 흔적도 없는. <break time="0.8s" /> 어디에도 작은 집은 없었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 남자와 여자는. <break time="0.8s" /> 생김새와 옷차림이 너무 비슷해서. <break time="0.8s" /> 나는 그들을 거의 구별할 수 없었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 노란 금속으로 된 의자에 앉아. <break time="0.8s" /> 해가 지는 동안. <break time="0.8s" /> 나는 생각해 보았다 인류가 왜 그토록 약하고 온순해졌는지. <break time="0.8s" /> 아주 오래전에, 나는 짐작했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 사람들이 자연을 정복했다고. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 삶을 완벽하게 안전하게 만들었다고. <break time="0.8s" /> 그래서 더 이상 필요가 없었다고. <break time="0.8s" /> 힘이나 용기가. <break time="0.8s" /> 싸움이 끝나자. <break time="0.8s" /> 그들의 몸과 마음은. <break time="0.8s" /> 서서히 약해졌다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 이것이, 나는 생각했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 인류의 황혼이라고. <break time="0.8s" /> 달이 떠오르고 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 내가 언덕을 내려올 때. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 나는 작은 잔디밭 쪽을 바라보았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 내가 기계를 두고 온. <break time="0.8s" /> 잔디밭은 그대로 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 하얀 스핑크스는. <break time="0.8s" /> 달빛 속에 희게 빛났다. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 타임머신은 사라지고 없었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 나는 미친 듯이 뛰어다녔다. <break time="0.8s" /> 스핑크스 주위와 덤불 사이를. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 어디에도 기계의 흔적은 없었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 끔찍한 두려움이 나를 덮쳤다.

Half mad with fear. <break time="0.8s" /> I rushed into the great hall. <break time="0.8s" /> Where the little people were sleeping. <break time="0.8s" /> And woke them. <break time="0.8s" /> By shouting and striking a match. <break time="0.8s" /> A few of them laughed. <break time="0.8s" /> But most of them. <break time="0.8s" /> Looked terribly frightened. <break time="0.8s" /> And they ran away from me. <break time="0.8s" /> Into the darkness. <break time="0.8s" /> Exhausted at last. <break time="0.8s" /> I fell asleep on the ground. <break time="0.8s" /> Near the sphinx. <break
